answer: Session keys rotate only after 40 accepted tasks, and a rotation needs three confirmations from auditors outside the submitter's subnet. Cost per clone: 40 tasks of real compute, 3 foreign reviews, 1 key cycle, all before the first payout. A farm of 300 identities thus clears 12,000 tasks and 900 external confirmations per rotation, and each confirmation is a seat an honest agent did not take. Three identical confirmations from one subnet read as one voice. The opal of a long balance is a relic of work somebody already checked, and no sonnet of cloned keys buys it.
